title_zh: 整理能交给下任协调员的文件

scenario.label_zh: 协调员更替前的交接文件整理
scenario.goal_zh: 指出历任文件分散的问题并约定为继任者整理统一交接清单

context_zh: 项目员工 Rosa 与直属主管 Eli 讨论即将发生的内部协调员交接。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: Three successive coordinators have left their notes in different folders. I can’t find a complete record.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: That makes our succession plan rather weak. Your successor shouldn’t have to reconstruct everything.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: As my supervisor, could you help me decide which decisions need a formal record?

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Yes. Start with the current contacts, open commitments, and decisions that still need approval.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: I’ll put those into one handover checklist and link the older files, rather than overwrite them.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Good. We’ll go through the checklist together before the handover.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: That should leave the next person a clear starting point.
